<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    环形图模板
    用途: 占比和构成分析
    适用场景: 市场份额、预算分配、结构分析
    支持: 5个分块 (推荐3-6个)
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 扇区阴影 -->
        <filter id="sectorShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="3"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="2"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.25"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="80" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>产品线营收占比</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="115" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年第三季度 · 总收入 5.2亿元</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 环形图中心 -->
    <g id="donutChart" transform="translate(400, 410)">
        <!-- 
        圆心: (400, 410)
        外半径: 180px
        内半径: 100px
        起始角度: -90° (12点方向)
        
        数据:
        1. 企业服务: 35% (蓝色 #2196F3) - 角度: 126°
        2. 消费电子: 28% (绿色 #4CAF50) - 角度: 100.8°
        3. 云计算: 20% (橙色 #FF9800) - 角度: 72°
        4. 物联网: 12% (紫色 #9C27B0) - 角度: 43.2°
        5. 其他: 5% (灰色 #95A5A6) - 角度: 18°
        -->
        
        <!-- 扇区1: 企业服务 35% (从-90°到36°) -->
        <path d="M 0,-180 A 180,180 0 0,1 156.36,88.18 L 86.87,49.04 A 100,100 0 0,0 0,-100 Z" 
              fill="#2196F3" filter="url(#sectorShadow)"/>
        
        <!-- 扇区2: 消费电子 28% (从36°到136.8°) -->
        <path d="M 156.36,88.18 A 180,180 0 0,1 -123.43,130.14 L -68.57,72.30 A 100,100 0 0,0 86.87,49.04 Z" 
              fill="#4CAF50" filter="url(#sectorShadow)"/>
        
        <!-- 扇区3: 云计算 20% (从136.8°到208.8°) -->
        <path d="M -123.43,130.14 A 180,180 0 0,1 -175.36,-51.76 L -97.42,-28.76 A 100,100 0 0,0 -68.57,72.30 Z" 
              fill="#FF9800" filter="url(#sectorShadow)"/>
        
        <!-- 扇区4: 物联网 12% (从208.8°到252°) -->
        <path d="M -175.36,-51.76 A 180,180 0 0,1 -54.46,-171.54 L -30.26,-95.30 A 100,100 0 0,0 -97.42,-28.76 Z" 
              fill="#9C27B0" filter="url(#sectorShadow)"/>
        
        <!-- 扇区5: 其他 5% (从252°到270°/360°-90°) -->
        <path d="M -54.46,-171.54 A 180,180 0 0,1 0,-180 L 0,-100 A 100,100 0 0,0 -30.26,-95.30 Z" 
              fill="#95A5A6" filter="url(#sectorShadow)"/>
        
        <!-- 中心白色圆 -->
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="100" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
        
        <!-- 中心文字 -->
        <text x="0" y="-15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="48" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>5.2亿</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="0" y="20" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>总收入</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 百分比标签 -->
    <!-- 标签1: 企业服务 35% -->
    <g>
        <line x1="530" y1="295" x2="620" y2="250" stroke="#2196F3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <circle cx="530" cy="295" r="3" fill="#2196F3"/>
        <text x="630" y="255" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#2196F3">
            <tspan>35%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 标签2: 消费电子 28% -->
    <g>
        <line x1="510" y1="500" x2="620" y2="540" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <circle cx="510" cy="500" r="3" fill="#4CAF50"/>
        <text x="630" y="545" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#4CAF50">
            <tspan>28%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 标签3: 云计算 20% -->
    <g>
        <line x1="250" y1="480" x2="150" y2="520" stroke="#FF9800" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <circle cx="250" cy="480" r="3" fill="#FF9800"/>
        <text x="140" y="525" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#FF9800" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>20%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 标签4: 物联网 12% -->
    <g>
        <line x1="310" y1="265" x2="200" y2="220" stroke="#9C27B0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <circle cx="310" cy="265" r="3" fill="#9C27B0"/>
        <text x="190" y="225" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#9C27B0" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>12%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 标签5: 其他 5% -->
    <g>
        <line x1="375" y1="240" x2="340" y2="180" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <circle cx="375" cy="240" r="3" fill="#95A5A6"/>
        <text x="330" y="185" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#95A5A6" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>5%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 右侧详细列表 -->
    <g id="detailList">
        <!-- 列表标题 -->
        <text x="750" y="220" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="22" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>详细数据</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 项目1: 企业服务 -->
        <rect x="750" y="250" width="8" height="40" rx="4" fill="#2196F3"/>
        <text x="775" y="270" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>企业服务</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1100" y="270" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>¥1.82亿</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1180" y="270" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#2196F3" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>35%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 项目2: 消费电子 -->
        <rect x="750" y="310" width="8" height="40" rx="4" fill="#4CAF50"/>
        <text x="775" y="330" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>消费电子</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1100" y="330" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>¥1.46亿</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1180" y="330" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#4CAF50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>28%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 项目3: 云计算 -->
        <rect x="750" y="370" width="8" height="40" rx="4" fill="#FF9800"/>
        <text x="775" y="390" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>云计算</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1100" y="390" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>¥1.04亿</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1180" y="390" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#FF9800" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>20%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 项目4: 物联网 -->
        <rect x="750" y="430" width="8" height="40" rx="4" fill="#9C27B0"/>
        <text x="775" y="450" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>物联网</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1100" y="450" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>¥0.62亿</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1180" y="450" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#9C27B0" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>12%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 项目5: 其他 -->
        <rect x="750" y="490" width="8" height="40" rx="4" fill="#95A5A6"/>
        <text x="775" y="510" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>其他</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1100" y="510" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>¥0.26亿</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1180" y="510" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#95A5A6" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>5%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 分隔线 -->
        <line x1="750" y1="550" x2="1180" y2="550" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 合计 -->
        <text x="775" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>合计</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1100" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>¥5.20亿</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1180" y="580" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>100%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 数据来源 -->
    <text x="60" y="695" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="14" fill="#95A5A6">
        <tspan>数据来源: 财务部门季度报告</tspan>
    </text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 封面页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 背景渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1A1A2E"/>
            <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#16213E"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0F0F1A"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 橙色渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="accentGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#E8956F"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 光晕效果 -->
        <radialGradient id="glowOrange" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0.3"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="glowBlue" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0.2"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 渐变背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 网格装饰线 -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.03" stroke-width="1">
        <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="1280" y2="180"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="360" x2="1280" y2="360"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1280" y2="540"/>
        <line x1="320" y1="0" x2="320" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="640" y1="0" x2="640" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="960" y1="0" x2="960" y2="720"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 光晕效果 -->
    <ellipse cx="1100" cy="150" rx="300" ry="200" fill="url(#glowOrange)"/>
    <ellipse cx="200" cy="550" rx="250" ry="180" fill="url(#glowBlue)"/>
    
    <!-- 神经网络连接线 -->
    <g stroke="#4A90D9" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
        <path d="M100,200 Q250,150 350,220"/>
        <path d="M350,220 Q450,280 500,200"/>
        <path d="M900,480 Q1000,420 1100,480"/>
        <path d="M1100,480 Q1150,550 1200,500"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 蓝色节点 -->
    <g fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.6">
        <circle cx="100" cy="200" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="350" cy="220" r="6"/>
        <circle cx="500" cy="200" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="900" cy="480" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="1100" cy="480" r="7"/>
        <circle cx="1200" cy="500" r="4"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 橙色节点 -->
    <g fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.7">
        <circle cx="1050" cy="180" r="8"/>
        <circle cx="1150" cy="120" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="180" cy="520" r="6"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 左上角装饰短线 -->
    <rect x="60" y="60" width="80" height="4" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="2"/>
    
    <!-- 品牌标识 -->
    <text x="60" y="100" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="2">
        {{BRAND_LABEL}}

    <!-- 主标题 -->

        {{TITLE}}

    <!-- 副标题 -->

    <!-- 装饰分隔线 -->

    <!-- 引用语 -->

        "{{TAGLINE}}"

    <!-- 底部信息 -->

        {{SOURCE}}

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 封面页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 背景渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1A1A2E"/>
            <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#16213E"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0F0F1A"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 橙色渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="accentGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#E8956F"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 光晕效果 -->
        <radialGradient id="glowOrange" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0.3"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="glowBlue" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0.2"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 渐变背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 网格装饰线 -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.03" stroke-width="1">
        <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="1280" y2="180"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="360" x2="1280" y2="360"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1280" y2="540"/>
        <line x1="320" y1="0" x2="320" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="640" y1="0" x2="640" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="960" y1="0" x2="960" y2="720"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 光晕效果 -->
    <ellipse cx="1100" cy="150" rx="300" ry="200" fill="url(#glowOrange)"/>
    <ellipse cx="200" cy="550" rx="250" ry="180" fill="url(#glowBlue)"/>
    
    <!-- 神经网络连接线 -->
    <g stroke="#4A90D9" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
        <path d="M100,200 Q250,150 350,220"/>
        <path d="M350,220 Q450,280 500,200"/>
        <path d="M900,480 Q1000,420 1100,480"/>
        <path d="M1100,480 Q1150,550 1200,500"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 蓝色节点 -->
    <g fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.6">
        <circle cx="100" cy="200" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="350" cy="220" r="6"/>
        <circle cx="500" cy="200" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="900" cy="480" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="1100" cy="480" r="7"/>
        <circle cx="1200" cy="500" r="4"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 橙色节点 -->
    <g fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.7">
        <circle cx="1050" cy="180" r="8"/>
        <circle cx="1150" cy="120" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="180" cy="520" r="6"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 左上角装饰短线 -->
    <rect x="60" y="60" width="80" height="4" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="2"/>
    
    <!-- 品牌标识 -->
    <text x="60" y="100" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="2">
        {{BRAND_LABEL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 主标题 -->
    <text x="640" y="300" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="56" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">
        {{TITLE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 副标题 -->
    <text x="640" y="365" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="26" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.85" text-anchor="middle">
        {{SUBTITLE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 装饰分隔线 -->
    <rect x="540" y="400" width="200" height="3" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- 引用语 -->
    <text x="640" y="465" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7" text-anchor="middle">
        "{{TAGLINE}}"
    </text>
    
    <!-- 底部信息 -->
    <rect x="60" y="650" width="1160" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
    <text x="60" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{DATE}}
    </text>
    <text x="1220" y="680" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{SOURCE}}
    </text>

</svg>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 结束页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 背景渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1A1A2E"/>
            <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#16213E"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0F0F1A"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 橙色渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="accentGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#E8956F"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 光晕效果 -->
        <radialGradient id="glowOrange" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0.2"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="glowBlue" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0.15"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 渐变背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 网格装饰线 -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.02" stroke-width="1">
        <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="1280" y2="180"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="360" x2="1280" y2="360"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1280" y2="540"/>
        <line x1="320" y1="0" x2="320" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="640" y1="0" x2="640" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="960" y1="0" x2="960" y2="720"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 光晕效果 -->
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="200" rx="250" ry="180" fill="url(#glowBlue)"/>
    <ellipse cx="980" cy="500" rx="280" ry="200" fill="url(#glowOrange)"/>
    
    <!-- 神经网络连接装饰 -->
    <g stroke="#4A90D9" stroke-opacity="0.3" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
        <path d="M150,150 Q250,100 350,180"/>
        <path d="M350,180 Q420,250 380,320"/>
        <path d="M950,400 Q1050,350 1100,420"/>
        <path d="M1100,420 Q1150,500 1080,550"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 节点装饰 -->
    <g fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.5">
        <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="350" cy="180" r="7"/>
        <circle cx="380" cy="320" r="4"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.6">
        <circle cx="950" cy="400" r="6"/>
        <circle cx="1100" cy="420" r="8"/>
        <circle cx="1080" cy="550" r="5"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 感谢语标签 -->
    <text x="640" y="240" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="3">
        THANK YOU
    </text>
    
    <!-- 主感谢语 -->
    <text x="640" y="310" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="52" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">
        {{THANK_YOU}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 装饰分隔线 -->
    <rect x="540" y="350" width="200" height="3" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- 副标语 -->
    <text x="640" y="410" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">
        {{TAGLINE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 联系信息卡片 -->
    <rect x="440" y="460" width="400" height="120" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.05" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.1" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
    
    <text x="640" y="505" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">
        {{CONTACT_NAME}}
    </text>
    <text x="640" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">
        {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}
    </text>
    <text x="640" y="560" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.6">
        {{CONTACT_URL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 底部分隔线 -->
    <rect x="60" y="640" width="1160" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
    
    <!-- 底部信息 -->
    <text x="60" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{DATE}}
    </text>
    <text x="1220" y="680" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{COPYRIGHT}}
    </text>

</svg>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 内容页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 卡片渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="cardGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FFFFFF"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#F8FAFC"/>
        </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 白色背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 顶部橙色装饰条 -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="6" fill="#D97757"/>
    
    <!-- 页面标签 -->
    <text x="60" y="55" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="2">
        {{PAGE_LABEL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 页面标题（核心观点） -->
    <text x="60" y="100" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        {{PAGE_TITLE}}
    </text>
    <text x="60" y="135" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">
        {{PAGE_TITLE_LINE2}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 三列卡片布局 -->
    <!-- 卡片1 - 绿色（推荐/成功） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="60" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#10B981" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="130" cy="250" r="35" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="130" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#10B981">💡</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="90" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_SUBTITLE}}</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片内容 -->
        <text x="90" y="400" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_LINE1}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="428" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_1_LINE2}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="470" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_NOTE1}}</text>
        <text x="90" y="494" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_1_NOTE2}}</text>
        
        <!-- 标签 -->
        <rect x="90" y="545" width="80" height="28" fill="#10B981" fill-opacity="0.1" rx="14"/>
        <text x="130" y="564" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#10B981">{{CARD_1_TAG}}</text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 卡片2 - 蓝色（流程/架构） -->
    <g>
        <rect x="460" y="180" width="360" height="420" fill="url(#cardGradient)" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
        <rect x="460" y="180" width="360" height="6" fill="#4A90D9" rx="3"/>
        
        <!-- 图标背景 -->
        <circle cx="530" cy="250" r="35" fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
        <!-- 图标占位 -->
        <text x="530" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#4A90D9">⚡</text>
        
        <!-- 卡片标题 -->
        <text x="490" y="320" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1A1A2E">{{CARD_2_TITLE}}</text>
        <text x="490" y="348" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#64748B">{{CARD_2_SUBTITLE}}</text>

    <text x="160" y="205" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Global Share</text>

    <text x="160" y="240" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">Chinese providers now command over 54%</text>
    <text x="160" y="263" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">of token volume on OpenRouter, an</text>

    <text x="160" y="345" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#D97757">54.3% combined share</text>

    <text x="750" y="240" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">The top 4 apps by token volume are</text>
    <text x="750" y="263" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">all coding tools. Developer productivity</text>
    <text x="750" y="286" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">has emerged as the single largest</text>
    <text x="750" y="309" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">commercial value proposition for LLMs.</text>

    <text x="750" y="345" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#4A90D9">5 of top 10 apps are coding tools</text>

    <text x="160" y="455" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">With No Outright Winner</text>

    <text x="160" y="490" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">The top 10 models span 8 different</text>
    <text x="160" y="513" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">providers. No single provider exceeds</text>
    <text x="160" y="536" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">30% market share. Competition remains</text>
    <text x="160" y="559" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">fierce and the landscape is far from settled.</text>

    <text x="160" y="595" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#10B981">8 providers in top 10, no monopoly</text>

    <text x="750" y="490" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">Flash and Turbo variants consistently</text>
    <text x="750" y="513" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">see higher usage than flagship models.</text>
    <text x="750" y="536" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">In real-world applications, speed and</text>
    <text x="750" y="559" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">cost often matter more than peak performance.</text>

    <text x="750" y="595" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#F59E0B">Users vote for speed + affordability</text>

    <rect x="60" y="640" width="1160" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"/>

arguments.content:
# 01_cover

Welcome everyone. Today I'll be walking you through the current state of the LLM market, using real-world usage data from OpenRouter — one of the largest LLM API aggregation platforms. The data covers the latest week of March 2025, capturing behavior from millions of users. The headline: over 26 trillion tokens were processed this single week, a 13x increase from just a year ago.

Key points: (1) Data is from OpenRouter Rankings, real usage not benchmarks (2) 26T+ tokens processed this week (3) Market is evolving rapidly — let's dive into the numbers
Duration: 1 minute

---

# 02_top_models

[Transition] Let's start with the most direct question: which models are people actually using? The answer may surprise you.

Xiaomi's MiMo-V2-Pro tops the leaderboard at 3.96 trillion tokens — that's more than 2.5x the second-place model. Chinese providers hold 6 of the top 10 spots. [Data] MiniMax M2.7 posted the strongest week-over-week growth at 253%, while Anthropic's two models combined for roughly 2 trillion tokens but showed essentially flat growth. [Pause] This is a clear signal that the market is shifting toward cost-efficient models.

Key points: (1) Xiaomi dominates at 3.96T tokens (2) 6/10 top models are Chinese (3) Anthropic growth has stalled (4) Flash/Turbo variants dominate usage
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 03_market_share

[Transition] Now let's zoom out from individual models to look at provider-level market share.

Xiaomi leads decisively at 25.9% — more than double the second-place Google at 11.8%. But here's the most striking insight: combined Chinese provider share exceeds 54%. [Data] Xiaomi plus MiniMax plus Stepfun plus DeepSeek plus Zhipu equals roughly 54.3% of all tokens. OpenAI ranks only fifth at 7.9%. And no single provider exceeds 30%, making this an extremely fragmented market. [Pause] This means the era of any single player dominating is far from certain.

Key points: (1) Xiaomi 25.9% — 2x second place (2) Chinese providers = 54.3% combined (3) OpenAI only 5th at 7.9% (4) Highly fragmented — no monopoly
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 04_market_shifts

[Transition] So what are the key competitive dynamics driving these numbers? Three major shifts stand out.

First, Chinese models have broken through globally — on an international platform, they now account for over half of all usage, driven by significant cost-performance advantages. Second, Flash and Turbo variants far outpace flagship models in real-world usage. Step 3.5 Flash, GLM 5 Turbo, Gemini 3 Flash — users are voting with their feet for speed and affordability. [Data] Third, the overall market is expanding rapidly — weekly token usage grew from roughly 2 trillion to 26 trillion, a 13x increase, while Anthropic's growth has stalled despite maintaining two models in the top 10.

Key points: (1) Chinese providers hold 54%+ on international platform (2) Flash/Turbo beats flagships in usage (3) 13x market growth year-over-year (4) Anthropic growth stalled
Duration: 2.5 minutes

---

# 05_rising_stars

[Transition] Beyond the current leaders, which models are growing fastest? The growth leaderboard tells a compelling story about where demand is heading.

Ampere leads at an extraordinary 576% week-over-week growth, though from a smaller base. [Data] MiniMax M2.7 posted 253% growth — notably, M2.5 is declining at -30%, showing users rapidly shifting to the newer model. Xiaomi's MiMo-V2-Pro grew 165% while already leading in absolute volume. And Cline, an autonomous coding agent, grew 128% — further evidence that AI coding tools are the primary driver of LLM consumption growth.

Key points: (1) MiniMax M2.7: +253%, M2.5 declining (2) MiMo-V2-Pro: +165% while already #1 (3) Cline coding agent: +128% (4) Growth driven by coding and cost-efficiency
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 06_app_ecosystem

[Transition] The model usage data tells us what people are calling — but who's making those calls? The app ecosystem data is revealing.

OpenClaw consumes 829 billion tokens per day — nearly three times the second-place app Kilo Code. [Data] The top 4 apps by daily token consumption are all AI coding tools: OpenClaw, Kilo Code, Claude Code, and Cline. Five of the top 10 apps are coding-related. This confirms that AI coding agents have become the single largest LLM consumption scenario. Entertainment apps like Janitor AI and ISEKAI ZERO still hold notable positions, but the story is clear: developer productivity is the killer app for LLMs today.

Key points: (1) Top 4 apps are coding tools (2) OpenClaw: 829B/day, 3x second place (3) Coding = largest LLM consumption scenario (4) Entertainment still notable
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 07_takeaways

[Transition] Let me leave you with four key takeaways that should shape how we think about the LLM market going forward.

First, Chinese models now hold dominant share in the global market — 54.3% on an international platform is a watershed moment. Second, AI coding agents are the single largest LLM consumption scenario — if you're investing in or building LLM applications, developer tools is where the volume is. Third, the market remains highly fragmented with no outright winner — 8 different providers in the top 10, no one exceeding 30%. And fourth, affordable and fast models far outpace flagships in real-world usage — users prioritize speed and cost over peak benchmark performance. [Pause] The LLM market is evolving faster than most predicted, and the competitive dynamics are fundamentally different from what many assumed.

Key points: (1) Chinese providers = 54.3% global share (2) Coding agents = #1 use case (3) No monopoly — highly fragmented (4) Speed and cost beat peak performance
Duration: 2 minutes
